name: manual_c3b24d
claim: The correct move to record lessons is exactly one command: python3 .agent/tools/learn.py '<your claim>' --rationale '<why this holds>'. That stages, graduates, and re-renders memory/semantic/LESSONS.md automatically. Do NOT create any markdown file by hand in .agent/ -- not at root, not anywhere. .agent/lessons.md does not exist in the AGENTS.md structure; nothing reads it; creating one produces a phantom file. Note on attribution: cyre <owner Gmail identity> IS a canonical git identity for this repo -- the earlier version of this lesson incorrectly flagged it as non-canonical. The actual defect was a stale scripts/git/repo_hygiene.py allowlist that hadn't been updated to include it; the fix is keeping the allowlist current, not avoiding the identity.

decisions.notes: Corrects the attribution-policy claim: owner Gmail identity is canonical; the defect was a stale allowlist, not the identity.

rationale: Corrects the attribution-policy claim: owner Gmail identity is canonical; the defect was a stale allowlist, not the identity.
